get.summary: List ALL restaurants — active and inactive — for admin management.

put.summary: Update one or more fields of an existing restaurant. Only supplied fields are changed.

get.summary: List ALL menu items for a restaurant (including unavailable ones).

post.summary: Add a menu item to a restaurant.

put.summary: Update fields of a menu item, e.g. price or availability. Only supplied fields are changed.

delete.summary:
Delete a menu item. Rejected with 409 if the item appears in any historical order —
in that case set IsAvailable=false via the update endpoint instead.

post.summary: Register a new user. Set `isAdmin` to true for Admin, false for User. Returns a JWT on success.
Login with email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.

get.summary: Get the current user's cart. Returns an empty cart if none exists yet.

delete.summary: Empty the cart entirely (also frees it to accept a different restaurant next).

post.summary:
Add a menu item to the cart, or increment quantity if it's already there.
A cart can only contain items from one restaurant at a time.

delete.summary: Remove a single menu item from the cart.

post.summary: Place an order from the current user's cart. Empties the cart on success.

get.summary: Get the current user's order history (newest first).
Get a specific order belonging to the current user.
List ALL orders across the system. Optional filters by status and restaurant.

parameters.name: restaurantId
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to a single restaurant.

patch.summary: Admin updates the status of an order. Delivered / Cancelled orders are terminal and can't be changed.

get.summary: List all ACTIVE restaurants. Visible to any logged-in user.
Get details of a single active restaurant.
List the available menu items for an active restaurant.

Cart.description:
Each user has at most one cart. A cart can hold items from only ONE restaurant at a time.
When the cart is emptied, RestaurantId becomes null again.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT token. Example: eyJhbGci...
